rule: every row names WHICH AGSS21 column it is against and what the residual measures. A forbidden line is LTE-insensitive (AGSS21's two columns are identical) so 1D-LTE vs 3D isolates the atmosphere; a molecular band has no NLTE grid either side; a permitted atomic line is compared to the 3D-LTE column because the 3D-NLTE column differs by physics we did not apply. Differencing against whichever column is closer would manufacture agreement (RYA-161).
